import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

grouped = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
grouped.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, color=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff', '#99ff99'])
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Size')
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.legend(title='Size', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
